title: Supported optimizer runtime integrations
description:
Purpose: Integrate Plexus optimization workflows through stable, supported Tactus lifecycle, model, telemetry, storage, and timeout interfaces.

Exclusions:
- Runtime monkeypatching or private method replacement.
- Silent storage, provider, or execution fallbacks.
- Duplicating deployment commits owned by another active session.

Dependencies: Current Tactus package publication and Plexus dependency integration are external prerequisites owned by the deployment session. This epic records the durable integration contract and follow-up verification.

Definition of Done:
- Plexus uses released public Tactus APIs for every optimizer runtime integration.
- Dependency compatibility and supported extension points have contract tests.
- Local and hosted storage behavior is explicit and fails clearly when unavailable.
- Repository agent guidance explicitly prohibits monkeypatching owned dependencies instead of improving their public APIs.
- No private runtime replacement or silent fallback remains.
- Behavior-first specifications and focused tests pass.

Running log: Record sanitized decisions, attempts, outcomes, and next steps in this epic or its child issues.
